actions.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The expedition leader fails a Survival check

Effect The expedition leader rethinks their choices based on prior experience. The degree of success increases by one step, from critical failure to failure or from failure to success.
actions.name: Memories of Expeditions Past
actions.trigger: The expedition leader fails a Survival check

actions.description:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
actions.name: Reactive Strike
actions.trigger: A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

actions.description: The expedition leader Interacts to take out their machete or shortbow, then Strikes with the weapon.
actions.name: Quick Draw

actions.description:
Requirements The expedition leader has a hand free

Effect The expedition leader scoops up a handful of rubble and throws it. Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save or be Dazzled and Off-Guard until the start of the expedition leader's next turn.
actions.name: Think Fast!
actions.requirements: The expedition leader has a hand free

actions.description: The expedition leader isn't affected by severe weather and ignores difficult terrain.
actions.name: Familiarity with the Land

actions.description:
When the expedition leader Scouts, they grant their party a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.

Effect: On Guard
actions.name: On Guard

name: Expedition Leader
publicNotes:
Full-scale expeditions require a central leader. Expedition leaders tend to have level heads in dangerous situations and can make decisions quickly when time is of the essence.

Explorers are often well-equipped and well-trained for any type of hazard and are eager to lead others into the wild.
